create_MOLEDGL_segment_mm_layer: create a MOLEDGL layer that uses fairchem_cpp segment_mm for efficient expert-weighted matrix multiplication
init_MOLE_linear_weights: initialize random linear weights and optional bias for a given number of experts and feature dimensions
compute_interval_intersection: compute the intersection of two numeric intervals and return the overlapping range or None
